title: Bad stream input panics instead of being dropped
body:
Version: 0.12.0 (b828807d)

These inputs panic in release builds. Other bad input already logs `UNEXPECTED` and is dropped, for example a duplicate BlockMeta (`wrapper.rs:427`).

| Input | Panic | Line |
|---|---|---|
| BlockMeta `blockhash` that does not parse | `expect("blockhash format")` | `dragonsmouth/proto_adapter.rs:47` |
| Entry `hash` that is not 32 bytes | `expect("entry hash length")` | `dragonsmouth/proto_adapter.rs:65` |
| One `bank_id` in two slots | `assert_eq!(slot, frozen_block.slot)` | `state_machine.rs:1236` |

The third one happens because `block_buffer_map` is keyed by `bank_id` only, so the freeze gets the block of the other slot. On 0.12.0 the bank must also look complete, so it is rare. It can happen across a reconnect to another node, because client 15 bank IDs are per connection.

shipstern tests hit the second and third on 0.11.0, which has the same code:
- `proto_adapter.rs:65`: `entry hash length: TryFromSliceError(())`
- `state_machine.rs:1213`: `assertion left == right failed, left: 101, right: 100`

I did not run the first case.

Suggested fix: `extract_geyser_ev_info` already returns `Option`, so return `None` for the first two. For the third, log `UNEXPECTED` and refuse the freeze. solana-rpc/shipstern#353 adds guards for all three, and shipstern would remove them.
